action.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS vendor_count FROM (SELECT vendor_id FROM (SELECT vendor_id, strftime(bill_date, '%Y-%m') AS bill_month, SUM(amount) AS monthly_total FROM ap_bills WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND bill_date >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND bill_date < DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY vendor_id, strftime(bill_date, '%Y-%m') HAVING SUM(amount) > 3000) qualifying_months GROUP BY vendor_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT bill_month) = 6) qualifying_vendors
